images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down desk simulation in the vein of Papers, Please but warmer and tactile: a post-office lost-parcel sorting desk under flickering fluorescent light, olive-green linoleum with fine grain. Left half: an opened kraft cardboard box with torn tape and straw, its contents laid out and tagged — a single red hand-knitted child's mitten, a blue-striped intercity bus ticket, a yellow hearing-aid battery card with half the cells used, a faded family snapshot. Paper clue tags pinned to each item, red, blue and yellow threads running from the tags across the desk to a clipboard on the right. The clipboard holds a resident ledger with three candidate cards with small portraits; the middle card for an elderly woman glows highlighted with '일치 4/4'. A large red rubber-stamp button reads '배송 확정'. A brass magnifying loupe brightens the mitten. Bottom: a conveyor belt of queued parcels. Top HUD: '분실물 창고', '07 / 20', amber digital clock '14:32'. Painterly semi-realistic illustration, warm kraft browns, olive, cream paper, stamp red, soft grain and vignette.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same sorting desk after hours: the room is dark navy, a single desk lamp throws a warm pool of amber light. In the center, the same kraft parcel has come back, wrapped in red '반송' return tape with a crossed-out address label and a rough red '오배송' rubber stamp. The mitten's cuff pokes out of a torn corner and a violet ultraviolet lamp reveals a glowing hand-embroidered name '도윤' inside it — the clue the player missed. A handwritten complaint note in blue ink is taped to the desk at an angle. On the right, a lined ledger sheet titled '일일 정산' lists twenty numbered deliveries with green check marks and two red crosses highlighted, and a double-ruled total '₩ 77,000'. Amber clock '21:07' in the top left, a yellow button '다음 날 ▸'. Painterly semi-realistic illustration, chiaroscuro lighting, deep blue shadows, amber lamp glow, UV violet accent, film grain, heavy vignette, quiet reckoning mood. Exact ledger: rows 1–20, every row fee "₩4,000"; all rows have green checks except rows 7 and 15, which are highlighted red with red crosses and fee "₩0"; the double-ruled total reads exactly "₩ 72,000". The mitten is the same single red hand-knitted child's mitten from the daytime screen (red wool, not grey or blue). No calendar date or year anywhere — only the clock "21:07".
